title: Connecting to the corporate VPN
content: To work remotely, install GlobalProtect from the Company Portal. Portal address: vpn.example.com. Sign in with your corporate e-mail and approve the MFA prompt. If the connection drops every few minutes, switch the protocol to IPSec in Settings > Connection. Error 'Gateway not found' means your client is outdated: uninstall it and reinstall from the Company Portal. The VPN is required for internal sites (intranet, HR portal, Jira).

title: Resetting a forgotten password
content: Go to https://passwordreset.example.com, enter your corporate e-mail and complete the MFA challenge. New passwords need at least 14 characters and cannot reuse your last 5 passwords. After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes; it unlocks automatically. If you no longer have access to your MFA device, the helpdesk must verify your identity: create a ticket with priority HIGH.

title: Setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA)
content: Install Microsoft Authenticator on your phone, then open https://aka.example.com/mfa-setup and scan the QR code. Keep at least two methods registered (app + SMS). When you change phones, add the new device before wiping the old one. Lost or stolen phone: report it immediately through a ticket with priority CRITICAL so the device can be revoked.

title: Adding a network printer
content: On Windows open Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners > Add device. Office printers are named PRN-<floor>-<number>, for example PRN-3-02. If the printer is not listed, connect to \\print.example.com and double-click it. Jobs stuck in the queue: restart the Print Spooler service or remove and re-add the printer. Paper jams and toner are handled by Facilities, not IT.

title: Outlook is not syncing e-mail
content: First check https://status.example.com for an ongoing incident. Then restart Outlook, and if the issue persists start it in safe mode (outlook.exe /safe). A full mailbox (limit 50 GB) stops new mail: archive old items via File > Tools > Mailbox Cleanup. To rebuild the local cache, close Outlook, rename the .ost file under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Outlook and restart. Shared mailbox access is requested through a ticket.

title: Requesting a new laptop or hardware
content: Standard laptops are replaced every 4 years. Hardware requests (laptop, monitor, docking station, headset) are made through a ticket that includes the business justification and the manager's name. Broken devices under warranty are swapped within 3 business days. Accessories under 100 EUR (mouse, keyboard) can be picked up at the IT desk on floor 2 without a ticket.

title: Installing software
content: Approved software is self-service in the Company Portal (Windows) or Self Service app (macOS). Employees do not have local admin rights. Software not in the portal needs a ticket with the product name, version and license information; the security team reviews requests within 5 business days. Browser extensions are managed by policy and cannot be installed manually.

title: Wi-Fi access in the office
content: Employees connect to the CORP network with their corporate credentials; the device must be enrolled in device management. Visitors use CORP-GUEST: the receptionist issues a 24-hour voucher. If CORP keeps asking for the password, forget the network and reconnect after changing your password. Slow connections in meeting rooms are often caused by too many devices; use the wired dock when available.
